item.title: Here We Are!
item.description: My name is Molly Isaacs-McLeod, JD, LL.M., president of Gifted Unlimited, LLC. Welcome! I am glad you are here! Gifted Unlimited has been in the making for some time now. item.title: Emotionally Gifted and Navigating the World
item.description: by Nicole A. Tetreault, Ph.D. High emotional capacity is a blessing and a curse. We need these individuals to open our eyes to be more empathetic, caring, and develop creative solutions to better society. item.title: Help Your Middle Schooler Go from Survive to Thrive
item.description: by Judy Willis, M.D., Ed.D. During the middle school years, your child’s brain undergoes a growth spurt unlike any other since his first few months of life. The adolescent brain experiences a unique and powerful makeover, pruning away of all the unneeded bits of memory it has collected but not used since infancy.
